reference_tables.intro: Listed here are all of the Items in the game, in the order that the game lists them.

rows.detail: Long used for its medicinal properties, this herb blooms only once each year. Those lucky enough to see the small blossom are said to enjoy good health for the year.
The seeds of the medicinal herb Thera Leaf. Extremely nourishing, they greatly restore physical strength when ingested. No taste. Easily portable, they are valued highly by adventurers.
Gathered from the Thera Leaf plant 5 years after the blossoms appear. Each plant has only one precious root. It dramatically restores physical strength.
Extract of the Thera Root further refined and purified. It has excellent restorative properties for physical strength. Difficult to make and very scarce.
A mystical, scarlet herb that grows in secret places. When taken by those with psychic or magic abilities, consumed mystical strength is again restored.
The seed of the mystical herb Mana Leaf, born only once every 2 years and having a hard shell. Dried under moonlight. Restores lost mystical strength.
Main root of the mystical herb Mana Leaf. Taken from the mature plant and exposed to the light of 20 full-moon nights. Powerful restorer of mystical strength.
A secret medicine made by putting the extract of Mana Roots under a magical process. Gives off a perfume and a blue glow. It fully restores mystical strength.
A magical herb used by ancient magic users such as shamans when practicing their craft. It changes the secretions of the brain, influencing one's state of mind.
The seeds of the magical Pure Leaf, soaked in a special medicinal liquid for 15 years. They have a powerful tranquilizing effect.
The root of the magical Pure Leaf. Made from the most poisonous part, but made safe to ingest. Makes one fearless of death or the enemy in battle.
Concentrated, distilled liquid of Pure Root. It contains fragments of spirit stone. When ingested, one feels a great sense of exhilaration. Warriors have long used it before taking on mighty enemies.
A cloth talisman embroidered in silk with pictures describing the Laws of Space. It can return the bearer from Unconsciousness and restore a small amount of strength.
A papyrus talisman with a picture of the holy man Hylas on it. Infused with the fragrance of incense, it awakens the Unconscious traveler and restores his strength.

cells: Restores Unconscious person's HP 30% and restores 50 MP.
rows.detail: A talisman bearing a portrait of the theologian and philosopher Somel. Awakens one from Unconsciousness and restores physical and mystical strength.

cells: Restores Unconscious person's HP 30% and restores 3 SP.
rows.detail: Goatskin talisman cured in holy water. Upon it, painted in mineral dyes, is a crudely beautiful painting of the sky through a window. Returns bearer from Unconsciousness and restores physical and mental strength.

cells: Fully restores Unconscious person's HP, MP, and SP
rows.detail: A talisman bearing the buried shrine crest, made from some unknown material. Fully restores physical, mystical and mental strength and cures Unconsciousness.

The number of facets on this gem represent a holy number. This deep blue gem is cut from an ore excavated from undersea ruins. With its mysterious detoxifying properties, it is very useful to adventurers traveling unexplored regions.
A small statue of the head of a woman, it cures Confusion. It is modeled after the figure of his mother a martyred sculptor carved into the stone of his prison.
A Shinto artifact made from light blue metal that has undergone a mystical process, it cures Paralysis. Although it is metal, it is extremely flexible and light, hence the name "Angel's Feather".
A small relief carving of a girl with wings, it cures Silence. In the Middle Ages, reproductions were all the rage among noblewomen.
Thought to be a fossil from some mysterious ancient creature. Effective in curing Petrification, some mountain tribes even now wear it as a charm from infancy.

cells: Cancels out all Judgment Ring abnormalities
rows.detail: A tail feather from the sacred phantom bird. When used, it emits a blue flame and cancels out all effects on the Judgment Ring.
A rare woodblock engraved with an image of the mythic nymph Daphne. Cures all Status abnormalities--Poison, Paralysis, Petrification, Confusion and Silence.
Tea prepared in the manner originated by the healer Shuju. Brewed from sacred leaves, it restores physical and mystical strength when imbibed with a pure heart.
A secret medicine passed down through the generations of the conquering Sou family, it dramatically restores the physical and mystical strength of soldiers.
The secret medicine prepared by Saint Ignatius. Restores physical and mystical strength. It gives off a red glow under the light of the moon.
Musky fruit of the mystical tree whose top reaches up into the heaves and whose roots descend into Hell. It restores physical and mystical strength completely.
A brew of secret black magic ingredients. Every mouthful brings an ever- changing series of flavors. It restores mystical and mental strength.
Wine made by the miracle-worker priest Rasfarus by adding his own and a few drops of a woman's blood to muddy water. Restores mystical and mental strength.
Distilled water the alchemist Gala, who lives to be 400 years old, accidentally discovered trying to produce platinum. Restores mystical and mental strength.
A religious artifact of elaborate workmanship, studded with gem beads. Many crude replicas exist, but the original fully restores mystical and mental strength.
Long used for hunting by mountain tribes with mystic powers. It doubles the width of the Judgment Ring hit area, although only for the user.

cells: User's indicator sweeps half as fast
rows.detail: An hourglass filled with granules of silver. Slows the speed of the indicator's sweep around the Judgment Ring by half, but only for the user.

cells: All allies' indicators sweep half as fast
rows.detail: An hourglass filled with granules of gold. Slows the speed of the indicator's sweep around the Judgment Ring by half for all allies.

cells: User's hit area is cut in half, but Attack Power doubles.
rows.detail: A spiritual artifact shaped like the beard of the White Tiger, a god of the four directions. User's Attack Power is doubled, but hit area is cut in half.

cells: All allies' hit areas are cut in half, but Attack Powers double
rows.detail: A spiritual artifact shaped like the horn of the Blue Dragon, a god of the four directions. Allies' Attack Powers are doubled, but hit areas are cut in half.

cells: User's indicator sweeps twice as fast, but Attack Power doubles.
rows.detail: A spiritual artifact shaped like the fang of the Black Tortoise, a God of the Four Directions. User's Attack Power is doubled, but Ring sweet speed is also doubled.

cells: All allies' indicators rotate twice as fast; Attack doubles
rows.detail: A spiritual artifact shaped like the talon of the Red Phoenix, a god of the four directions. Allies' Attack Powers are doubled, but Ring sweep speeds are also doubled.

cells: Makes user's attacks all critical hits
rows.detail: A sliver magic tool in the image of the star swallow, said to bring victory in battle. Has the power to make all of the user's attacks critical hits.

cells: Makes all allies' attacks All critical hits
rows.detail: A magic tool in the image of the mythical bird, the moon swallow. Has the power to make all of the attacks of all allies critical hits.

cells: User's Hit Area doubles; Indicator sweeps half-speed
rows.detail: A scale from the body of the mythical creature, the kirin. It has an effect on the Judgment Ring, doubling the user's hit area and halving sweep speed.

cells: Indicator speed becomes irregular; Attack Power triples
rows.detail: A paw of the white monkey that inhabits the deep forests of the sacred mountains. It triples the user's Attack Power, but speed of Ring sweep becomes irregular.
This magic tool gives off a mysterious blue light under the new moon. It increases the chance of success to the maximum for all of the user's actions.

cells: Attack Power increases with continued successful actions
rows.detail: A tool of the magic army that appears in the myth of the 20 Days War. Attack Power becomes gradually more effective with each continued successful action.

cells: 1 to 3 allies gain triple strength, misses possible
rows.detail: Dice said to be made from the bones of Caesar, it's unclear whether they're lucky or unlucky. A rare item popular with gamblers. Won't work with Key to Success.

cells: Max 3 sweeps of indicator with successful action
rows.detail: A magical weapon Elroy gave a vassal during the 20 Days War of the Gods. If an action is successful, can get up to 3 sweeps of indicator on Judgment Ring.

cells: Max 5 sweeps of indicator with successful action
rows.detail: A magical weapon Elroy gave a vassal during the 20 Days War of the Gods. If an action is successful, can get up to 5 sweeps of indicator on Judgment Ring.

cells: Max 7 sweeps of indicator with successful action
rows.detail: A magical weapon said to be used by Elroy during the 20 Days War of the Gods. If an action is successful, can get up to 7 sweeps of indicator on Judgment Ring.
A small object of art found in the tomb of the great adventurer Amlas after his death. It is said to increase the user's maximum physical strength.
A metal sculpture inlaid with a mysterious plant, excavated from the holy ground of the warlocks, the mountain peak Docia. It raises maximum mystical strength.
A carving of a feather of the Red Phoenix, owned by the ancient Indian ruler Muta. It raises the user's maximum mental strength.
A carving in the shape of a lion, made from the bones of the right arm of the legendary fighter Malbellus. Increases the user's strength.
An object of art, a metal engraving of the mysterious rafflesia flower. When used, stamina and defense against Physical Attack is raised.
A spiritual artifact depicting Lapros, a mythic bird that flies faster than lightning. Raises reaction speed, improving hit rates and avoidance of enemy attack.
A Shinto spiritual artifact depicting the left eye of Cluce, the god of wisdom and magic. It increases the effectiveness of magic and special items.
A portrait of the white witch Reska, inlaid with her own hair. It raises defense against magic attack.
A spiritual artifact instilled with the mystical strength of the guardian deity of gambling, Morgagius. Raises critical hit rates and avoidance of enemy attack.
Issued by the World Lottery Foundation. Secret members all over the world ask you to participate in lotteries. Get wonderful prizes through luck and skill!

cells: For blowing noses and other wiping
rows.detail: A lottery consolation prize. Used mainly for wiping noses. Handy to have in many situations. Contains 8 tissues.

cells: Restores all allies. Only useable at a Save Point
rows.detail: A leather tent used by nomadic tribes. It can be used at a Save Point to fully restore the physical, mystical and mental strength of all allies.
